description: Windows desktop component for the Launcher Android app, providing local-network notes and shared-file access (Kevin Loggenberg)
notes: The official Windows executable is published as a self-contained win-x64 single-file .NET application. Scoop downloads the executable directly and does not run an installer.

The launcher redirects LOCALAPPDATA to data\Local and DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR to data\dotnet. The application's server certificate, stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\LauncherCompanion, is therefore kept in Scoop's persistent data directory.
Keep the Launcher console window open while the phone is connected. Closing the window stops the local server.
The downloaded LauncherCompanion.exe is not Authenticode-signed. No LICENSE file or license declaration was found in the upstream repository; the manifest therefore marks the license as Unknown.

The upstream download uses an opaque, per-upload file identifier rather than a version-derived URL. checkver reads the application version from the upstream project file, but autoupdate is intentionally omitted because a future download URL cannot be derived safely.
